notes.title: Dark Witch Ep4 Demo Released!
notes.content: [p]Thank you for your patience! The demo for [i]The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 4[/i] is now available.[/p][p]The full version is scheduled for release later this year, so stay tuned![/p][p]We've set up separate language-specific threads in the Community Hub for bug reports and feedback.[/p]

notes.title: The Steam store for The Legend of Dark Witch: Episode 4 is LIVE!
notes.content:
The Steam store for The Legend of Dark Witch: Episode 4 is LIVE!
Don't forget to add it to your wishlist and get ready for the adventure!
